about_the_game:
🐌 About the Game 🐌

In Tiny Company, you are the owner of a cozy little shop that specializes in creating custom terrariums. But unlike most stores, your clients are not people, they’re the actual future inhabitants of the terrariums! From ants and beetles to snakes, geckos, mantises, and snails, each visitor arrives with a specific vision for their dream home, and it’s your job to bring it to life.

🕹️ Gameplay 🕹️

Each client greets you with a short dialogue and a reference photo of the terrarium they’d like you to build. You must observe and recreate their desired layout using the available decorative elements in your shop. Using your mouse, you’ll click on boxes, sacks, or crates to release items, and then drag and position them inside the container.

But there’s a catch: once you place an object, you can’t move it again. Precision, observation, and planning are essential to deliver a design that makes your tiny customer feel truly at home.

⭐ Progression & Scoring ⭐

After completing a terrarium, your design is evaluated based on accuracy and creativity, with a final score between 0 and 3 stars. Depending on how well you’ve captured the client’s vision, their reactions will vary, sometimes sweet, sometimes disappointed.

As you earn stars, you unlock new levels with different creatures, each presenting new decorative challenges. You can always revisit previous levels to try for a better score.

💬 Join the Community 💬

Join our official Discord server to connect with other players, suggest new ideas, report bugs, or just chat with a great group of people.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • Processor: Any dual-core processor (Intel i3 or equivalent)
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics (Intel HD 4000 or equivalent)
  • Storage: 100 MB MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10, macOS 10.13, or later
  • Processor: Intel i5 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU (NVIDIA GTX 660 or equivalent) for smoother performance
  • Storage: 100 MB available space

short_description: In Tiny Company you run a cozy little shop where you design custom terrariums for tiny clients.Have a chat with quirky critters, learn their personalities, follow their oddly instructions, and design the home of their dreams.
